rows.text: zeroes dword `[rcx]`; with `n` = dword `[rdx]` AND 0x7FFFFFFF takes `p` = 0 when `n` is 0, else the result of the call at `001C1C00` + 0x3A with (`n`*8, 8), and when `p` is non-null makes the call at `001C1C00` + 0x50 with (`p`, qword `[rdx+8]`, `n`); stores `p` to qword `[rcx+8]`, and `n` to dword `[rcx]` when `p` is non-null, else 0; returns `rcx`

stores 0 to dword `[rcx]` and qword `[rcx+8]` and copies dword `[rdx+0x10]` to dword `[rcx+0x10]`; when that dword is 0 returns `rcx` at once; otherwise makes the call at `0067ACF0` + 0x3B with (`rcx`, dword `[rdx]` with bit 31 cleared) and, when qword `[rcx+8]` is then non-null, the call at `0067ACF0` + 0x50 with (that qword, qword `[rdx+8]`, dword `[rcx+0x10]`); returns `rcx`

notes: 0067ACF0: the cmovne at 0067AD20 selects qword [rdx+8] only when dword [rdx+0x10] is non-zero, which is already guaranteed on that path, so the sentence states it unconditionally. 001C1C00: the jbe at 001C1C2F follows the AND and so branches only on n = 0.
